svg.title: Network Security Scanner - real firewall enforcement and SIEM alerts
svg.desc: Flask and Nmap scanner. Rules run real iptables or netsh commands, ports that opened since the last scan raise Wazuh alerts, and the Wazuh rules are tested on Wazuh 4.14.9 in CI.

g.text: Flask and Nmap. Rules run real iptables or netsh commands, and new
open ports raise SIEM alerts in Wazuh.
